answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Ridge Rule. Each identity’s action vector is projected onto a low-dimensional behavioural ridge fitted from its own prior epochs; any epoch whose projection deviates beyond a calibrated bound is quarantined from rewards and governance until re-earned over subsequent epochs. A whisper of shared coordination across fresh identities cannot fake persistent individual trajectories, since each must independently maintain consistent behaviour over many epochs.
